title: dispatch resumes a returned worker with a prompt file, detached
goal: backlog.py dispatch ID --resume SESSION --prompt FILE resumes a returned worker in its worktree with the prompt on stdin, as dispatch starts one; SP-3pvz2noj: the orchestrator built the resume argv by hand three times and once started it with no prompt

run:
import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', 'dispatch', '--help'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert '--resume' in r.stdout, 'dispatch has no --resume'
